entries.title: I Peter 5:1
segments: The elders among you I exhort, who am a fellow-elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, who am also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

entries.title: I Peter 5:2
segments: Tend the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not of constraint, but willingly, according to [the will of] God; nor yet for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

entries.title: I Peter 5:3
segments: neither as lording it over the charge allotted to you, but making yourselves ensamples to the flock.

entries.title: I Peter 5:4
segments: And when the chief Shepherd shall be manifested, ye shall receive the crown of glory that fadeth not away.

entries.title: I Peter 5:5
segments: Likewise, ye younger, be subject unto the elder. Yea, all of you gird yourselves with humility, to serve one another: for God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.

entries.title: I Peter 5:6
segments: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;

entries.title: I Peter 5:7
segments: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.

entries.title: I Peter 5:8
segments: Be sober, be watchful: your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour,

entries.title: I Peter 5:9
segments: whom withstand stedfast in your faith, knowing that the same sufferings are accomplished in your brethren who are in the world.

entries.title: I Peter 5:10
segments: And the God of all grace, who called you unto his eternal glory in Christ, after that ye have suffered a little while, shall himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.

entries.title: I Peter 5:11
segments: To him [be] the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: I Peter 5:12
segments: By Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I account [him], I have written unto you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand ye fast therein.

entries.title: I Peter 5:13
segments: She that is in Babylon, elect together with [you], saluteth you; and [so doth] Mark my son.

entries.title: I Peter 5:14
segments: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be unto you all that are in Christ.
